alana: Quick follow-up on the gateway/edge resume idea I sketched last week. Proposal: attach a tiny "stream-snapshot" header to ingress sessions so edge can resume idempotently without full model KV checkpointing. posted a short design and tradeoffs link: https://internal/rfcs/stream-snapshot (see bullets). Thoughts?
matt: high level sounds good. main worry is memory/metadata blowup on busy gateways. what size are we expecting per-session?
alana: target <=128 bytes per active session. design: fixed header with base64(payload) where payload is (stream_id, seq, model_variant, hmac). edge keeps LRU table keyed by stream_id. evict when >N or mem>threshold.
sophia: replay/security concern: can this be forged to resume someone else's session?
alana: agree. include per-customer HMAC using tenant KMS-derived key and a versioned key id in the header. header carries kid and hmac. we'll validate in control-plane or edge at resume.
kevin: rollback/backcompat: what if older clients don't send header or header is malformed mid-stream?
alana: graceful: missing/invalid header => opaque restart (no resume). allow canary opt-in via header flag. no behaviour change for default.
matt: how does this interact with hedging/early-fallbacks? if hedged requests race you might have two different resume tokens for same logical stream.
alana: each stream_id is unique per logical session; hedged attempts carry the same stream_id. control-plane assigns consistent model_variant and sequence semantics. if two different variants respond, runtime picks highest-priority variant and records its seq in snapshot.
rica: what metrics should we add to verify impact?
alana: good Q. propose: counter resume.attempts, resume.success, resume.failures(reason), snapshot.evictions, avg.snapshot.size, resume.latency.p95. correlate resume.success with token-savings and tail-latency.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: gateway/stream-snapshot v0.1 -> infra-canary-2 at 1729823499 :rocket:
matt: curious about wire format. can you paste minimal example header?
alana: sure:```
X-RW-Stream-Snap: v1|kid=kp_42|sid=abc123|seq=834|mv=gpt-j-6b|h=base64_hmac
```
sophia: what about privacy? smaller header could leak model variant choices per request in logs. we should avoid persisting full header in plaintext logs.
alana: agreed. plan: edges redact header in access logs, only emit metrics (flags). control-plane audit log stores sanitized entries with tenant scoping.
kevin: rollout plan + owners?
alana: rollout plan draft: 1) internal canary (infra teams) 48h, 2) opt-in beta customers (support + platform) 2 weeks, 3) gradual ramp with fallback windows + kill switch. owners: alana (spec + rollout), matt (edge implementation + mem caps), sophia (security review), kevin (ops readiness), rica (telemetry). I'll open a follow-up RFC with toy impl and perf targets.
matt: ack, will prototype LRU and eviction metrics.
sophia: will do threat model and KMS flow.
rica: I'll add dashboards and alerts for resume.failures and evictions.
alana: thanks team. I'll post the RFC draft and link it here. action: alana create RFC by Fri, matt proto by next Wed, sophia sec review in parallel.
